corePillars.title: 99.4% On-Time Arrival Guarantee
corePillars.description: Vehicles are pre-assigned and staged 45 minutes prior to designated reporting time with GPS geo-fence departure confirmation.
corePillars.remedy: Automated incident logging and immediate dispatch of secondary standby vehicle upon 10-minute threshold breach.

corePillars.title: 20-Minute Breakdown Replacement
corePillars.buffer: Dedicated standby buffer fleet at core hubs
corePillars.description: In the rare event of mechanical malfunction or puncture, an equivalent or higher-category vehicle is dispatched from the nearest corridor hub.
corePillars.remedy: 100% fare credit waiver for the impacted leg plus dedicated priority Ground Marshal escort.

corePillars.title: 12-Point Pre-Dispatch Cabin Readiness

corePillars.title: Zero-Tolerance Sobriety & Verified Vetting
corePillars.description: Daily digital sobriety log, active police CCTNS background verification, valid commercial passenger license endorsement, and POSH training.
corePillars.remedy: Immediate driver deboarding, permanent roster debarment, and replacement chauffeur assigned within 15 minutes.

corePillars.title: Transparent Invoicing & SAC 9966 Compliance

faqs.question: What happens if a vehicle arrives late due to severe traffic or road closure?
faqs.answer: Our GPS telematics algorithms constantly monitor corridor congestion. If a delayed arrival is anticipated past the 10-minute threshold, our control center dispatches a secondary standby vehicle from a closer staging hub, ensuring zero interruption to the corporate schedule.

faqs.question: How are corporate SLA credits or penalties calculated and reconciled?
faqs.answer: All trips are tracked via automated digital GPS stamps. In the event of an SLA default verified against telematics data, a pre-agreed contractual credit rebate is applied directly against the monthly consolidated invoice under Level 4 Partner signoff.

faqs.question: Can enterprise clients audit Victor Mobility's driver background and vehicle fitness records?
faqs.answer: Yes. Corporate HR and compliance teams have access to our digital Chauffeur Badge Verification Desk (/india/academy/verify) and can request physical or notarized compliance dossiers prior to contract execution.

faqs.question: What are Victor Mobility's standard corporate billing and credit terms?
faqs.answer: We offer 30-day net credit terms for verified corporate entities subject to standard vendor onboarding. Consolidated GST-compliant monthly invoices are delivered alongside itemized digital trip logs.

faqs.question: Are Victor Mobility's UAE vehicles fully licensed by Dubai RTA?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our entire UAE fleet operates under official Dubai RTA Luxury Limousine commercial franchise permits, with RTA-approved telematics, calibrated digital meters, and fully credentialed RTA chauffeurs.

faqs.question: How do you handle airport arrivals if flights are delayed into DXB?
faqs.answer: Our dispatch team monitors live ADS-B flight telemetry for all commercial and private aviation arrivals. Chauffeur dispatch times automatically adjust to actual touchdown times with complimentary 60-minute terminal buffer waiting.

faqs.question: Do you support cross-border transfers between Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Oman?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer coordinated inter-emirate transfers between Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the Northern Emirates, as well as insured cross-border transit to Muscat, Oman with appropriate commercial insurance extensions.

faqs.question: How do corporate clients establish credit accounts in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Corporate entities can submit their trade license and TRN certificate to our corporate accounts desk for 30-day net billing terms backed by automated FTA-compliant monthly electronic invoices.
